hypothesis: Dense pitch-group experts have stable positive source gain and large true-group headroom, but the first dense expert recipe deliberately removed every group-specific TrackMan profile to match exact C. Giving each expert only its own completed-history group physics profile may improve its conditional control probability without exposing current-pitch TrackMan.

relationship_to_prior_work.dense_moe_parent: V5_DENSE_PITCHTYPE_MOE_V1 trained full dense experts with exact-C features after dropping all e58 group-specific physics columns.
relationship_to_prior_work.trackman_global_failures: Prior global/LUPI/archetype directions did not combine a dense known-group training expert with only that group's frozen physics profile.
relationship_to_prior_work.new_information_path: expert identity supplies the historical group; that expert receives only e58_<same_group>_* completed-history columns.

data_contract.physics_cutoff: official TrackMan matched R rows with season strictly before the predicted row season

candidate.selector: dense counter-label CatBoost with row-local e53 K20 state and all frozen group physics profiles
candidate.experts: three reverse_any CatBoost experts; common exact-C features plus only the matching e58 group-specific profile
candidate.blend_formula: F remains exact parent; R = parent + gamma * (dense physics MoE - parent)
candidate.selection: maximize minimum full gain across 2020/2021, then minimum R gain, then smaller gamma

source_gate.on_pass: Freeze gamma and recipe before 2022/2023; open 2024 only after both development and honest-anchor gates pass.
